description: Update two TypeScript pages to implement the member portal UI: (1) app/(main)/clubs/[slug]/page.tsx — add member-only sections (membership card + club badges + announcements) rendered only when caller_membership.status === 'active'; (2) app/(main)/clubs/[slug]/manage/page.tsx — add Announcements tab for club_admin and event_manager. Implementation: const diff = Date.now() - new Date(dateStr).getTime(); const secs = Math.floor(diff/1000); if (secs < 60) return 'just now'; const mins = Math.floor(secs/60); if (mins < 60) return `${mins} minute${mins===1?'':'s'} ago`; const hrs = Math.floor(mins/60); if (hrs < 24) return `${hrs} hour${hrs===1?'':'s'} ago`; const days = Math.floor(hrs/24); if (days < 30) return `${days} day${days===1?'':'s'} ago`; const months = Math.floor(days/30); return `${months} month${months===1?'':'s'} ago`;
